system_prompt_style.note: AgentSys is a plugin layer running on host CLIs (Claude Code etc.); the system prompt is built by the host. Agent prompt files are not in the evidence bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Tools like `/drift-detect`, `/onboard`, `/can-i-help`, and planners consume this data instead of re-scanning the repo every time.
env_context_strategy.note: Cached repo-intel/repo-map data is injected, and exploration-agent also navigates the codebase. Inferred from README prose only.

context_compaction.note: OpenCode native plugin lists 'Session compaction', but the mechanism is not shown (adapters/opencode-plugin/index.ts not in the bundle). Compaction on the Claude host is done by the host.

observation_format.note: Observations are produced by the host CLI.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is done by the host CLI.

tool_count.note: The host provides the tools. 24 plugins, 49 agents and 44 skills are listed, but they are not tool schemas.

edit_primitive.note: Editing is done by host tools.

protocol_standardization.note: The docs mention an MCP server with pipeline integration.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Pipelines enforce phase gates so agents can't skip steps.
loop_primitives.note: The /next-task 12-phase pipeline is the default. The review loop iterates until clean, which is the generate_test_repair value. The ReAct loop of the host CLI is not coded.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Two JSON files track everything: what task, what phase.
planning_granularity.note: The planning-agent produces a plan and flow.json tracks the phase. Whether the plan itself is stored as an object is unclear.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The main workflow orchestrator doesn't read files, search code, or write implementations. It launches specialized agents and receives their outputs.
multi_agent_topology.note: /debate provides a debate topology as an option.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Phase 9 uses the `orchestrate-review` skill to spawn parallel reviewers

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: User Approval** - You review and approve the plan (last human interaction)
human_in_loop.note: The quote is taken from within a markdown bold span. Host CLI permission prompts are not coded here.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Turn a user's "stop doing this" correction into a persistent rule in `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md`.
long_term_memory.note: Skills are loaded from the plugin library. /enhance saves false positives across runs.

state_persistence.note: lib/state/workflow-state.js is present but was not opened.

self_verification.evidence_quote: **Delivery Validation** - Verifies tests pass, build passes, requirements met
self_verification.note: The multi-agent review loop is the llm_judge value. The deslop pipeline and optional CLI linters are the linters_typecheck value.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Review Loop** - Multi-agent review iterates until clean
retry_policy.note: /prepare-delivery caps the review loop at a maximum of 5 iterations.

rollback.note: Worktrees isolate work, but no revert mechanism is shown. /next-task --abort does cleanup.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Review loop** - 4 core reviewers + conditional specialists, max 5 iterations
termination_condition.note: The pipeline ends at a stopping point chosen by policy or at merge. Mapping this to model_declared is inferred.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Each agent has a single responsibility, a specific model assignment, and defined inputs/outputs.
cost_controls.note: Per-agent assignment of opus, sonnet or haiku by task complexity. repo-intel output is cached, but this is a data cache, not an LLM cache.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Runs the consultation with safe-mode defaults and 120s timeout
timeouts.note: The 120 s timeout covers /consult calls only.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: **Worktree Setup** - Creates isolated branch and working directory
execution_isolation.note: Runs inside the host CLI on the local machine. Git worktrees are not a sandbox.

permission_model.note: Hooks enforce phase gates, but the permission model is set by the host.

tracing.note: The quoted row is from the perf table (the source row reads 'perf-investigation-logger | Structured evidence logging'). The quote may not match verbatim because of the added bold formatting.

eval_hooks.note: No evaluation runner appears in the file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Hooks enforce this - agents literally cannot skip phases.
